CALC (SOLVE).description: Checks the current equation and makes a menu of its variables, to store values and solve for any one of them.

CALC (SUM).description: Opens the statistics of the current SUM list: total, mean, median, deviation, range, and FRCST for two lists.

CALC (TIME).description: Opens date arithmetic: the day of the week, days between dates, a date some days away.

CALL.description: The call price per 100 of face value; 100 for a yield to maturity.

CDATE.description: In an equation: today's date, from the clock.

CFLO.description: Cash flows: lists of uneven cash flows for net present value, internal rate of return and more.

CLEAR DATA.description: Clears the data of the menu on display: the variables of a menu such as TVM, the list in SUM or CFLO, or (in SOLVE) all equations after asking. From MAIN it clears the history stack.

CLR.description: Clears the calculator line. Pressed while the calculator is off, it turns it on.

CONT.description: Continuous compounding: the menu of NOM% and EFF%.

CORR.description: The correlation coefficient, from −1 to +1: how well the chosen model fits the two lists.

COST (MU%C).description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%C.

COST (MU%P).description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%P.

CPN%.description: The yearly coupon rate in percent.

CTIME.description: In an equation: the time now, from the clock.

DATE (APPT).description: Sets the appointment's date to the date shown.

DATE (SET).description: Sets the date to the number shown (MM.DDYYYY or DD.MMYYYY).

DATE(d1:n).description: In an equation: the date n days after d1 (before it when n is negative), in the date format set in TIME SET.

DATE1.description: The first date: stores the date shown (with its day of the week) or works it out from DATE2 and DAYS.

DATE2.description: The second date: stores the date shown or works it out from DATE1 and DAYS.

DAY.description: Repeats the appointment every so many days (the number shown).

DAYS.description: The actual number of days from DATE1 to DATE2, leap years counted. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

DB.description: The declining-balance depreciation for year YR#; ▼ then shows the remaining depreciable value.

DDAYS(d1:d2:cal).description: In an equation: the days from d1 to d2 on calendar cal: 1 actual, 2 the 365-day year, 3 the 360-day year.

DELET (SOLVE).description: Deletes the current equation, or only its variables.

DEPRC.description: Depreciation with one of four methods: straight line, declining balance, SOYD (sum of the years' digits) or ACRS.

DSP.description: Opens the DSP menu to set how numbers are shown: decimal places and the radix mark.

E.description: Starts the exponent of a number in scientific notation: 6 E 3 is 6,000.

EDIT.description: Opens the current equation in the ALPHA-Edit menu to change it.

EFF% (CONT).description: The effective yearly rate in percent of continuous compounding. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM%.

EFF% (PER).description: The effective yearly rate in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM% and P.

END.description: End mode: each payment comes at the close of its period, as with most loans.

EXIT.description: Goes back to the previous menu.

EXP.description: Raises e to the number shown.

EXP (FRCST).description: Fits an exponential curve, y = B·e^(M·x).

EXP(x).description: In an equation: e to the power x.

EXPM1(x).description: In an equation: e to the power x, less 1, exact for small x.

FACT%.description: The declining-balance rate, in percent of the straight-line rate (200 for double declining balance).

FACT(x).description: In an equation: the factorial of a whole number x.

FIN.description: Opens the finance menus: TVM, ICNV, CFLO, BOND, DEPRC.

FIRST.description: The first payment of the table to print.

FIX.description: Sets how many decimal places numbers show: type 0 to 11, then INPUT.

FLOW(list:n).description: In an equation: flow number n of the named CFLO list.

FP(x).description: In an equation: the fractional part of x.

FRCST.description: Two-list statistics: asks for the x list and the y list, then opens the menu for curve fitting, forecasts, weighted mean and summations.

FV.description: The future value: the amount at the close of the last period. Money paid out is negative.

G.SD.description: The standard deviation of the x values grouped by the frequencies in the y list.

GET (CFLO).description: Switches to another named cash-flow list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

GET (SUM).description: Switches to another named SUM list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

GO.description: Prints the amortisation table from FIRST to LAST in steps of INCR.

HELP (APPT).description: Shows the formats for an appointment's date and time.

HELP (SET).description: Shows how to key in the date and the time.

HMS(t).description: In an equation: hours with a decimal fraction turned into HH.MMSS.

HOUR.description: Repeats the appointment every so many hours (the number shown).

HRS(t).description: In an equation: a time in HH.MMSS turned into hours with a decimal fraction.

I% (CFLO).description: The interest rate per period used for NPV, NUS and NFV (cost of capital, discount rate).

I%YR.description: The nominal yearly interest rate, in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

ICNV.description: Interest conversion: between nominal and effective yearly rates, for periodic or continuous compounding.

IDIV(x:y).description: In an equation: the whole-number part of x divided by y.

IF(cond:then:else).description: In an equation: the value of then when cond is true, else the value of else. Conditions use = < > ≤ ≥ ≠ and AND, OR, XOR, NOT.

INCR.description: How many payments each line of the printed table covers.

INPUT.description: Enters the number or text typed: an item into a SUM or CFLO list, an equation into the Solver, or an answer to a prompt.

INSR (CFLO).description: Inserts a flow before the one shown.

INSR (SUM).description: Inserts an item before the one shown.

INT (AMRT).description: The part of the amortised payments that went to interest.

INT(x).description: In an equation: the largest whole number not above x.

INTL.description: Opens a menu to choose the language of the messages and labels.

IP(x).description: In an equation: the integer part of x, its fraction dropped.

IRR%.description: The internal rate of return per period: the discount rate that makes NPV of the flows zero.

ITEM(list:n).description: In an equation: item number n of the named SUM list.

LAST.description: Copies the last result into the calculator line, to use it again.

LAST (TABLE).description: The last payment of the table to print.

LIFE.description: The useful life in whole years.

LIN.description: Fits a straight line, y = B + M·x.

LIST.description: Prints the values of the menu on display, or the current SUM or CFLO list, or the appointments in the APPT menu.

LN.description: The natural (base e) logarithm of the number shown.

LN(x).description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of x.

LNP1(x).description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of 1 + x, exact for small x.

LOG.description: Base-10 logarithm of the number shown.

LOG (FRCST).description: Fits a logarithmic curve, y = B + M·ln x.

LOG(x).description: In an equation: the base-10 logarithm of x.

M.description: The M coefficient of the chosen model; the slope for the linear one.

M%C.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of COST. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

M%P.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of PRICE. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

M/D.description: Switches the date format from month/day/year to day.month.year and back.

MAIN.description: Goes straight back to the MAIN menu from any menu.

MAT.description: The maturity date, or the call date (which must be a coupon date).

MATH.description: Opens the MATH menu: logarithms, powers of 10 and e, factorial and π.

MAX.description: The biggest number of the list.

MAX(x:y).description: In an equation: the larger of x and y.

MEAN.description: The average (arithmetic mean) of the list.

MEM.description: Shows how many bytes of memory are free, and what percentage that is.

MIN (RPT).description: Repeats the appointment every so many minutes (the number shown).

MIN (SUM).description: The smallest value of the list.

MIN(x:y).description: In an equation: the smaller of x and y.

MOD(x:y).description: In an equation: the remainder of x divided by y, x − y·INT(x/y).

MODES.description: Opens the MODES menu: the beeper, the printer's power and the display language.

MODL.description: Opens the choice of curve-fitting model: LIN, LOG, EXP, PWR.

MORE (BOND).description: The second BOND menu: YLD%, PRICE, ACCRU.

MORE (DEPRC).description: The second DEPRC menu: YR#, FACT% and the three methods.

MORE (SUM CALC).description: The second CALC menu: MIN, MAX, SORT, FRCST.

MSG (APPT).description: Types or shows the appointment's message with the ALPHA menu.

MSG (PRINTER).description: Types a message of up to 22 characters with the ALPHA menu and prints it, to label a printout.

MU%C.description: Markup on cost: a menu with COST, PRICE and M%C.

MU%P.description: Markup on price: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%P.

N.description: How many payments or compounding periods there are. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the others. ⇧ N stores the number shown times P/YR (years to payments).

N!.description: The factorial of the number shown, a whole number from 0 to 253.

NAME (CFLO).description: Names or renames the current cash-flow list.

NAME (SUM).description: Names or renames the current SUM list.

NEW (%CHG).description: The new value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from OLD and %CH.

NEW (SOLVE).description: Starts a new equation: type it with the ALPHA menu and the keyboard, then press INPUT.

NEXT.description: Works out the next schedule of #P payments.

NFV.description: The net future value: NPV carried forward to the last period at I%.

NOM% (CONT).description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded continuously. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

NOM% (PER).description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded P times a year. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

NOT.description: In an equation's condition: true when what follows is false.

NPV.description: NPV of the cash flows at the rate I%: their net present value.

NUS.description: The net uniform series: the equal flow per period whose present value equals NPV.

OFF.description: Turns the calculator off. Continuous memory keeps everything.

OLD.description: The old value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NEW and %CH.

OR.description: In an equation's condition: true when either side is true.

OTHER (TVM).description: The second TVM menu: payments per year, begin or end mode, amortisation.

P.description: How many times a year interest is compounded.

P/YR.description: Sets how many payments there are per year, 1 to 999.

PART.description: The share of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

PER.description: Periodic compounding: the menu of NOM%, EFF% and P.

PMT.description: The amount of each equal payment. Money paid out is negative. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

PRICE (BOND).description: The price per 100 of face value. Stores the number shown, or works it out from YLD%.

PRICE (MU%C).description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%C.

PRICE (MU%P).description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%P.

PRIN.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to principal.

PRINTER.description: Opens the PRINTER menu: print the current menu's values or list, the stack, the registers, the time or a message.

PRNT.description: Tells the calculator whether the printer runs on its AC adapter (it then prints faster) or on batteries.

PRT.description: Prints what the display shows on the infrared printer.

PV.description: The present value: the loan amount or the first investment, at the start of the first period. Money paid out is negative.

PWR.description: Fits a power curve, y = B·x^M.

RANG.description: The biggest number of the list less the smallest.

RCL.description: Copies a register (followed by a digit 0-9) or a menu variable (followed by its menu key) into the calculator line, without calculating it.

RND(x:y).description: In an equation: x rounded to y places after the point (y from 0 to 11), or to −y significant digits (y from −12 to −1).

RPT.description: Shows how often the appointment repeats and opens the menu to change it.

S(var).description: In an equation: true when the Solver is solving for var. With IF it puts several related equations into one menu.

SALV.description: The salvage value left when the asset's life ends (0 if none).

SEMI.description: Coupons are paid twice a year.

SET.description: Opens the menu that sets the date and time and their formats.

SETT.description: The settlement (purchase) date, keyed in the date format in use.

SGN(x).description: In an equation: 1 when x is positive, 0 when it is zero, −1 when it is negative.

SHOW.description: Shows the number with all its 12 digits while the key is held.

SIZE.description: How many items each of the two lists holds.

SIZEC(list).description: In an equation: the number of the final flow of the named CFLO list.

SIZES(list).description: In an equation: how many items the named SUM list holds.

SL.description: Depreciation by the straight-line method for the year in YR#.

SOLVE.description: Opens the Solver: type your own equations and solve them for any variable.

SORT.description: Sorts the list from the smallest number up.

SOYD.description: Depreciation for the year in YR# by the SOYD method (sum of the years' digits).

SPFV(i%:n).description: In an equation: what 1 paid now is worth after n periods at i% per period, (1 + i%/100)^n.

SPPV(i%:n).description: In an equation: what 1 paid after n periods at i% per period is worth now, 1/SPFV(i%:n).

SQRT(x).description: In an equation: the square root of x.

STDEV.description: The sample standard deviation of the list.

STO.description: Stores the number shown: then press a digit 0-9 for a register or a menu key for a variable. STO + − × ÷ before the register does the arithmetic in it.

SUM.description: Opens SUM: lists of numbers, their running total and statistics.

TABLE.description: Opens the printing of an amortisation table: type the number of the final payment to print, then press START.

TIME.description: Shows the date and time and opens the TIME menu: date arithmetic, appointments, adjusting and setting the clock.

TIME (APPT).description: Sets the appointment's time to the time shown (HH.MM); a past date becomes today.

TIME (SET).description: Sets the time to the number shown (HH.MMSS).

TODAY.description: Puts today's date into the calculator line, to store in DATE1 or DATE2.

TOTAL (%TOTL).description: The whole amount, of which PART is a share. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

TOTAL (CFLO).description: All the cash flows of the list added up.

TOTAL (SUM CALC).description: All the numbers of the list added up.

TOTAL (SUM).description: Shows the total of the items in the list.

TRACE.description: Turns trace printing on or off: with it on, every calculation is printed as it is done.

TRN(x:y).description: In an equation: x cut off (not rounded) to y decimal places, or to −y significant digits when y is negative.

TVM.description: Time value of money: works out loans, savings, leases and their amortisation from five values (PV, PMT, FV, N and I%YR).

TYPE.description: Opens the menu of bond types: calendar and coupon frequency.

USFV(i%:n).description: In an equation: the future value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

USPV(i%:n).description: In an equation: the present value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

W.MN.description: The mean of the x values weighted by the y list.

WEEK.description: Repeats the appointment every so many weeks (the number shown).

XOR.description: In an equation's condition: true when exactly one side is true.

YLD%.description: The yearly yield in percent, to maturity or to the call date. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE.

YR#.description: The year to depreciate: 1, 2 and so on.

x².description: The square of the number shown.

yˣ.description: Raises the number before it to the power of the next one: 2 yˣ 3 = 8.

×.description: Multiplies the number before it by the next one.

÷.description: Divides the number before it by the next one.

Σ(ctr:c1:c2:s:expr).description: In an equation: the sum of expr as the counter ctr runs from c1 to c2 in steps of s.

ΣX.description: The sum of the x list.

ΣX2.description: The x values squared and added up.

ΣXY.description: Each x times its y, added up.

ΣY.description: The sum of the y list.

ΣY2.description: The y values squared and added up.

−.description: Subtracts the next number from the one before it.

√x.description: Square root of the number shown.

▲.description: Rolls the history stack up one line; in a list or the Solver, shows the previous item or equation.

▼.description: Rolls the history stack down one line; in a list or the Solver, shows the next item or equation.

⬅.description: Backspace: erases the last character typed, or the whole number when no cursor shows.

#P.description: Stores how many payments to amortise (1 to 1,200) and works out that schedule; the next one starts where it left off.

#T(list:n).description: In an equation: how many times flow n of the named CFLO list occurs.

#T?.description: Turns on or off the prompt asking how often each flow repeats.

%.description: Percent: after an operator, takes that percentage of the number before it (200 + 5 % adds 5% of 200); alone, divides the number by 100.

%CH.description: The change from OLD to NEW as a percentage of OLD. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

%CHG.description: Percent change: the menu of OLD, NEW and %CH.

%T.description: PART as a percentage of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

%TOTL.description: Percent of total: the menu of TOTAL, PART and %T.

(.description: Opens a parenthesis, so the part inside is worked out first.

+.description: Adds the next number to the one before it.

+/-.description: Makes the number being typed, or the result shown, negative or positive again.

+HR.description: Moves the clock one hour forward.

+MIN.description: Moves the clock one minute forward.

+SEC.description: Moves the clock one second forward.

, (DSP).description: Shows numbers with a decimal comma and periods between groups of digits: 1.234,50.

-HR.description: Moves the clock one hour back.

-MIN.description: Moves the clock one minute back.

-SEC.description: Moves the clock one second back.

. (DSP).description: Shows numbers with a decimal point and commas between groups of digits: 1,234.50.

1/x.description: The reciprocal of the number shown.

12/24.description: Switches between the 12-hour and the 24-hour clock.

360D.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 counted with 30-day months and a 360-day year.

365D.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 on a 365-day calendar, ignoring leap days.

=.description: Finishes the calculation on the calculator line and shows the result. In RPN mode this key is ENTER: it copies X into Y to start the next number.

A/PM (APPT).description: Switches the appointment's time from AM to PM or back (12-hour clock).

A/PM (SET).description: Switches the clock between AM and PM.

ABS(x).description: In an equation: x without its sign.

ACCRU.description: Interest accrued since the last coupon date up to settlement, per 100 of face value.

ACRS.description: The ACRS deduction: BASIS times ACRS%.

ACRS%.description: The ACRS percentage from the published tables.

ADJST.description: Opens the menu that moves the clock forward or back by an hour, a minute or a second.

ALG.description: Algebraic entry: 2 + 3 = gives 5. The calculator starts in this mode.

ALL.description: Shows numbers with as many digits as they need, up to 12.

ALOG(x).description: In an equation: 10 to the power x.

AMRT.description: Opens the amortisation menu, which splits payments into interest and principal and shows the balance.

AND.description: In an equation's condition: true when both sides are true.

ANN.description: Coupons are paid once a year.

APPT.description: Opens the ten appointments, with which are set and which are overdue.

APT1.description: Opens an appointment (APT1 to APT5 here, APT6 to APT10 under MORE) to set or see its date, time, message and repeat.

B.description: The B coefficient of the chosen model; the y-intercept for the linear one.

BASIS.description: What the asset cost when it was bought: its depreciable basis.

BEEP.description: Steps through the beeper settings: on, on for appointments only, off.

BEG.description: Begin mode: payments come at the start of each period, as with leases and savings plans.

LN.description: The natural (base e) logarithm of the number shown.

LN(x).description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of x.

LNP1(x).description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of 1 + x, exact for small x.

LOG.description: Base-10 logarithm of the number shown.

LOG (FRCST).description: Fits a logarithmic curve, y = B + M·ln x.

LOG(x).description: In an equation: the base-10 logarithm of x.

M.description: The M coefficient of the chosen model; the slope for the linear one.

M%C.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of COST. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

M%P.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of PRICE. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

M/D.description: Switches the date format from month/day/year to day.month.year and back.

MAIN.description: Goes straight back to the MAIN menu from any menu.

MAT.description: The maturity date, or the call date (which must be a coupon date).

MATH.description: Opens the MATH menu: logarithms, powers of 10 and e, factorial and π.

MAX.description: The biggest number of the list.

MAX(x:y).description: In an equation: the larger of x and y.

MEAN.description: The average (arithmetic mean) of the list.

MEM.description: Shows how many bytes of memory are free, and what percentage that is.

MIN (RPT).description: Repeats the appointment every so many minutes (the number shown).

MIN (SUM).description: The smallest value of the list.

MIN(x:y).description: In an equation: the smaller of x and y.

MOD(x:y).description: In an equation: the remainder of x divided by y, x − y·INT(x/y).

MODES.description: Opens the MODES menu: the beeper, the printer's power, double-space printing, ALG or RPN entry and the display language.

MODL.description: Opens the choice of curve-fitting model: LIN, LOG, EXP, PWR.

MORE (BOND).description: The second BOND menu: YLD%, PRICE, ACCRU.

MORE (DEPRC).description: The second DEPRC menu: YR#, FACT% and the three methods.

MORE (SUM CALC).description: The second CALC menu: MIN, MAX, SORT, FRCST.

MSG (APPT).description: Types or shows the appointment's message with the ALPHA menu.

MSG (PRINTER).description: Types a message of up to 22 characters with the ALPHA menu and prints it, to label a printout.

MU%C.description: Markup on cost: a menu with COST, PRICE and M%C.

MU%P.description: Markup on price: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%P.

N.description: How many payments or compounding periods there are. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the others. ⇧ N stores the number shown times P/YR (years to payments).

N!.description: The factorial of the number shown, a whole number from 0 to 253.

NAME (CFLO).description: Names or renames the current cash-flow list.

NAME (SUM).description: Names or renames the current SUM list.

NEW (%CHG).description: The new value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from OLD and %CH.

NEW (SOLVE).description: Starts a new equation: type it with the ALPHA menu and the keyboard, then press INPUT.

NEXT.description: Works out the next schedule of #P payments.

NFV.description: The net future value: NPV carried forward to the last period at I%.

NOM% (CONT).description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded continuously. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

NOM% (PER).description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded P times a year. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

NOT.description: In an equation's condition: true when what follows is false.

NPV.description: NPV of the cash flows at the rate I%: their net present value.

NUS.description: The net uniform series: the equal flow per period whose present value equals NPV.

OFF.description: Turns the calculator off. Continuous memory keeps everything.

OLD.description: The old value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NEW and %CH.

OR.description: In an equation's condition: true when either side is true.

OTHER (TVM).description: The second TVM menu: payments per year, begin or end mode, amortisation.

P.description: How many times a year interest is compounded.

P/YR.description: Sets how many payments there are per year, 1 to 999.

PART.description: The share of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

PER.description: Periodic compounding: the menu of NOM%, EFF% and P.

PMT.description: The amount of each equal payment. Money paid out is negative. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

PRICE (BOND).description: The price per 100 of face value. Stores the number shown, or works it out from YLD%.

PRICE (MU%C).description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%C.

PRICE (MU%P).description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%P.

PRIN.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to principal.

PRINTER.description: Opens the PRINTER menu: print the current menu's values or list, the stack, the registers, the time or a message.

PRNT.description: Tells the calculator whether the printer runs on its AC adapter (it then prints faster) or on batteries.

PRT.description: Prints what the display shows on the infrared printer.

PV.description: The present value: the loan amount or the first investment, at the start of the first period. Money paid out is negative.

PWR.description: Fits a power curve, y = B·x^M.

RANG.description: The biggest number of the list less the smallest.

RCL.description: Copies a register (followed by a digit 0-9) or a menu variable (followed by its menu key) into the calculator line, without calculating it.

RND.description: Rounds the number shown to the decimal places on display; later calculations use the rounded value.

RND(x:y).description: In an equation: x rounded to y places after the point (y from 0 to 11), or to −y significant digits (y from −12 to −1).

RPN.description: RPN entry: 2 ENTER 3 + gives 5. The = key becomes ENTER and the display shows X, the bottom register of a four-level stack.

RPT.description: Shows how often the appointment repeats and opens the menu to change it.

R↓.description: Rolls the history stack down one line (in RPN, the four registers X to T).

S(var).description: In an equation: true when the Solver is solving for var. With IF it puts several related equations into one menu.

SALV.description: The salvage value left when the asset's life ends (0 if none).

SEMI.description: Coupons are paid twice a year.

SET.description: Opens the menu that sets the date and time and their formats.

SETT.description: The settlement (purchase) date, keyed in the date format in use.

SGN(x).description: In an equation: 1 when x is positive, 0 when it is zero, −1 when it is negative.

SHOW.description: Shows the number with all its 12 digits while the key is held.

SIZE.description: How many items each of the two lists holds.

SIZEC(list).description: In an equation: the number of the final flow of the named CFLO list.

SIZES(list).description: In an equation: how many items the named SUM list holds.

SL.description: Depreciation by the straight-line method for the year in YR#.

SOLVE.description: Opens the Solver: type your own equations and solve them for any variable.

SORT.description: Sorts the list from the smallest number up.

SOYD.description: Depreciation for the year in YR# by the SOYD method (sum of the years' digits).

SPFV(i%:n).description: In an equation: what 1 paid now is worth after n periods at i% per period, (1 + i%/100)^n.

SPPV(i%:n).description: In an equation: what 1 paid after n periods at i% per period is worth now, 1/SPFV(i%:n).

SQRT(x).description: In an equation: the square root of x.

STDEV.description: The sample standard deviation of the list.

STO.description: Stores the number shown: then press a digit 0-9 for a register or a menu key for a variable. STO + − × ÷ before the register does the arithmetic in it.

SUM.description: Opens SUM: lists of numbers, their running total and statistics.

TABLE.description: Opens the printing of an amortisation table: type the number of the final payment to print, then press START.

TIME.description: Shows the date and time and opens the TIME menu: date arithmetic, appointments, adjusting and setting the clock.

TIME (APPT).description: Sets the appointment's time to the time shown (HH.MM); a past date becomes today.

TIME (SET).description: Sets the time to the number shown (HH.MMSS).

TODAY.description: Puts today's date into the calculator line, to store in DATE1 or DATE2.

TOTAL (%TOTL).description: The whole amount, of which PART is a share. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

TOTAL (CFLO).description: All the cash flows of the list added up.

TOTAL (SUM CALC).description: All the numbers of the list added up.

TOTAL (SUM).description: Shows the total of the items in the list.

TRACE.description: Turns trace printing on or off: with it on, every calculation is printed as it is done.

TRN(x:y).description: In an equation: x cut off (not rounded) to y decimal places, or to −y significant digits when y is negative.

TVM.description: Time value of money: works out loans, savings, leases and their amortisation from five values (PV, PMT, FV, N and I%YR).

TYPE.description: Opens the menu of bond types: calendar and coupon frequency.

USFV(i%:n).description: In an equation: the future value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

USPV(i%:n).description: In an equation: the present value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

W.MN.description: The mean of the x values weighted by the y list.

WEEK.description: Repeats the appointment every so many weeks (the number shown).

XOR.description: In an equation's condition: true when exactly one side is true.

YLD%.description: The yearly yield in percent, to maturity or to the call date. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE.

YR#.description: The year to depreciate: 1, 2 and so on.

x².description: The square of the number shown.

x≷y.description: Swaps the last two numbers of the history stack (in RPN the X and Y registers).

yˣ.description: Raises the number before it to the power of the next one: 2 yˣ 3 = 8.

×.description: Multiplies the number before it by the next one.

÷.description: Divides the number before it by the next one.

Σ(ctr:c1:c2:s:expr).description: In an equation: the sum of expr as the counter ctr runs from c1 to c2 in steps of s.

ΣX.description: The sum of the x list.

ΣX2.description: The x values squared and added up.

ΣXY.description: Each x times its y, added up.

ΣY.description: The sum of the y list.

ΣY2.description: The y values squared and added up.

−.description: Subtracts the next number from the one before it.

√x.description: Square root of the number shown.

▲.description: Rolls the history stack up one line; in a list or the Solver, shows the previous item or equation.

▼.description: Rolls the history stack down one line; in a list or the Solver, shows the next item or equation.

⬅.description: Backspace: erases the last character typed, or the whole number when no cursor shows.

#P.description: Stores how many payments to amortise (1 to 1,200) and works out that schedule; the next one starts where it left off.

#T(list:n).description: In an equation: how many times flow n of the named CFLO list occurs.

%.description: Percent: after + or −, takes that percentage of the number before it (1250 + 7 % adds 87.50); otherwise divides the number by 100.

%CH.description: The change from OLD to NEW as a percentage of OLD. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

%CHG.description: Percent change: the menu of OLD, NEW and %CH.

%T.description: PART as a percentage of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

%TOTL.description: Percent of total: the menu of TOTAL, PART and %T.

(.description: Opens a parenthesis, so the part inside is worked out first.

+.description: Adds the next number to the one before it.

+/−.description: Makes the number being typed, or the result shown, negative or positive again.

+HR.description: Moves the clock one hour forward.

+MIN.description: Moves the clock one minute forward.

+SEC.description: Moves the clock one second forward.

, (DISP).description: Shows numbers with a decimal comma and periods between groups of digits: 1.234,50.

-HR.description: Moves the clock one hour back.

-MIN.description: Moves the clock one minute back.

-SEC.description: Moves the clock one second back.

. (DISP).description: Shows numbers with a decimal point and commas between groups of digits: 1,234.50.

1/x.description: The reciprocal of the number shown.

12/24.description: Switches between the 12-hour and the 24-hour clock.

360D.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 counted with 30-day months and a 360-day year.

365D.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 on a 365-day calendar, ignoring leap days.

=.description: Finishes the calculation on the calculator line and shows the result. In RPN mode this key is ENTER: it copies X into Y to start the next number.

A/PM (APPT).description: Switches the appointment's time from AM to PM or back (12-hour clock).

A/PM (SET).description: Switches the clock between AM and PM.

ABS(x).description: In an equation: x without its sign.

AC.FT.description: A volume in acre-feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to acre-feet.

ACCRU.description: Interest accrued since the last coupon date up to settlement, per 100 of face value.

ACOS.description: The arc cosine of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

ACOS(x).description: In an equation: the arc cosine of x, in the angle mode in use.

ACOSH.description: Inverse hyperbolic cosine of the number shown (1 or more).

ACOSH(x).description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic cosine of x.

ACRE.description: An area in acres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to acres.

ACRS.description: The ACRS deduction: BASIS times ACRS%.

ACRS%.description: The ACRS percentage from the published tables.

ADJST.description: Opens the menu that moves the clock forward or back by an hour, a minute or a second.

ALG.description: Algebraic entry: 2 + 3 = gives 5. The calculator starts in this mode.

ALL.description: Shows numbers with as many digits as they need, up to 12.

ALOG(x).description: In an equation: 10 to the power x.

AMRT.description: Opens the amortisation menu, which splits payments into interest and principal and shows the balance.

AND.description: In an equation's condition: true when both sides are true.

ANGLE(x:y).description: In an equation: the polar angle of (x, y) as a point, in the angle mode in use.

ANN.description: Coupons are paid once a year.

APPT.description: Opens the six appointments, with which are pending and which are past due.

APPT1.description: Opens an appointment (APPT1 to APPT6) to set or see its date, time, message and repeat.

ASIN.description: The arc sine of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

ASIN(x).description: In an equation: the arc sine of x, in the angle mode in use.

ASINH.description: Inverse hyperbolic sine of the number shown.

ASINH(x).description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic sine of x.

ATAN.description: The arc tangent of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

ATAN(x).description: In an equation: the arc tangent of x, in the angle mode in use.

ATANH.description: Inverse hyperbolic tangent of the number shown (between −1 and 1).

ATANH(x).description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic tangent of x.

B.description: In the FRCST menu: the B coefficient of the model; the y-intercept for the linear one.

BAL.description: What is left of the loan after the amortised payments.

BASIS.description: What the asset cost when it was bought: its depreciable basis.

BBL.description: A volume in barrels of oil (42 US gallons): stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to barrels of oil (42 US gallons).

BD.FT.description: A volume in board feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to board feet.

BEEP.description: Steps through the beeper settings: on, on for appointments only, off.

BEG.description: Begin mode: payments come at the start of each period, as with leases and savings plans.

BOND.description: Bond price and yield on any date: coupons once or twice a year, on a 30/360 or an actual/actual calendar.

BU.description: A volume in bushels: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to bushels.

BUS.description: Opens the business menus: percent change and total, markups, currency exchange, unit conversions.

C.RCL.description: Recalls a pair of currencies and its rate stored with C.STO.

C.STO.description: Stores the two currencies and the rate under one of the menu keys, to recall them later with C.RCL.

CALC (CFLO).description: Opens the CFLO CALC menu: TOTAL, IRR%, I%, NPV, NUS, NFV for the current list.

CALC (SOLVE).description: Checks the current equation and makes a menu of its variables, to store values and solve for any one of them.

CALC (SUM).description: Opens the statistics of the current SUM list: total, mean, median, deviation, range, histogram, and FRCST for two lists.

CALC (TIME).description: Opens date arithmetic: the day of the week, days between dates, a date some days away.

CALL.description: The call price per 100 of face value; 100 for a yield to maturity.

CDATE.description: In an equation: today's date, from the clock.

CFLO.description: Cash flows: lists of uneven cash flows for net present value, internal rate of return and more.

CHAIN.description: A length in chains: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to chains.

CLEAR DATA.description: Clears the history stack, and with it the variables of the menu on display or the list it shows (SUM, CFLO, TEXT, the Solver's equations).

CM.description: A length in centimetres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to centimetres.

COMB(x:y).description: In an equation: how many ways there are to choose y items out of x, order not counted.

CONT.description: Continuous compounding: the menu of NOM% and EFF%.

CONV.description: Opens the conversions: degrees and radians, decimal hours and hours-minutes-seconds, and (MORE) polar and rectangular coordinates.

COPY.description: Copies the current list into a new list under the name you type.

CORR.description: In the FRCST menu: the correlation coefficient, from −1 to +1: how well the model fits the two lists.

COS.description: The cosine of the number shown, in the angle mode in use.

COS(x).description: In an equation: the cosine of x, in the angle mode in use.

COSH.description: The hyperbolic cosine of the number shown.

COSH(x).description: In an equation: the hyperbolic cosine of x.

COST (MU%C).description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%C.

COST (MU%P).description: The cost of an item. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE and M%P.

CPN%.description: The yearly coupon rate in percent.

CTIME.description: In an equation: the time now, from the clock.

CU.FT.description: A volume in cubic feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic feet.

CU.IN.description: A volume in cubic inches: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic inches.

CU.M.description: A volume in cubic metres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic metres.

CU.YD.description: A volume in cubic yards: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cubic yards.

CUP.description: A volume in cups: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to cups.

CURR.description: Replaces the label of the current item with the text typed.

CURR1.description: The first currency (US$ until another is chosen with SELCT): stores an amount in it, or converts the second currency's amount into it.

CURR2.description: The second currency (YEN until another is chosen with SELCT): stores an amount in it, or converts the first currency's amount into it.

CURRX.description: Currency exchange between two currencies at an exchange rate; the top line says how many units of the second one equal one of the first.

CWT.description: A mass in short hundredweights: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to short hundredweights.

CX,Y.description: The number of combinations: ways to choose Y items out of X, order not counted.

D.GAL.description: A volume in dry gallons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to dry gallons.

D/R.description: Switches the angle mode between degrees and radians; the RAD annunciator shows radians.

D/R (CONV).description: Switches the angle mode between degrees and radians.

DATE (APPT).description: Sets the appointment's date to the date shown.

DATE (SET).description: Sets the date to the number shown (MM.DDYYYY or DD.MMYYYY).

DATE(d1:n).description: In an equation: the date n days after d1 (before it when n is negative), in the date format set in TIME SET.

DATE1.description: The first date: stores the date shown (with its day of the week) or works it out from DATE2 and DAYS.

DATE2.description: The second date: stores the date shown or works it out from DATE1 and DAYS.

DAY.description: Repeats the appointment every so many days (the number shown).

DAYS.description: The actual number of days from DATE1 to DATE2, leap years counted. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

DB.description: The declining-balance depreciation for year YR#, with the remaining depreciable value.

DBL.description: Switches double-spaced printing on and off.

DDAYS(d1:d2:cal).description: In an equation: the days from d1 to d2 on calendar cal: 1 actual, 2 the 365-day year, 3 the 360-day year.

DEG(x).description: In an equation: x radians in decimal degrees.

DEL.description: Removes the character under the cursor.

DELET (SOLVE).description: Deletes the current equation, or only its variables.

DEMO.description: Runs the display demonstration; hold = to freeze it, press ON to end it.

DEPRC.description: Depreciation with one of four methods: straight line, declining balance, SOYD (sum of the years' digits) or ACRS.

DISP.description: Opens the DISP menu to set how numbers are shown: decimal places and the radix mark.

DISPL.description: Prints lines 1 to 3 of the display.

DRAM.description: A mass in drams: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to drams.

E.description: Starts the exponent of a number in scientific notation: 6 E 3 is 6,000.

EDIT (SOLVE).description: Opens the current equation for editing with the letter keys and the cursor keys.

EDIT (TEXT).description: Edits the current entry; also shows entries longer than 22 characters.

EFF% (CONT).description: The effective yearly rate in percent of continuous compounding. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM%.

EFF% (PER).description: The effective yearly rate in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NOM% and P.

END.description: End mode: each payment comes at the close of its period, as with most loans.

EXIT.description: Goes back to the previous menu.

EXP.description: Raises e to the number shown.

EXP (FRCST).description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits an exponential curve, y = B·e^(M·x).

EXP(x).description: In an equation: e to the power x.

EXPM1(x).description: In an equation: e to the power x, less 1, exact for small x.

FACT%.description: The declining-balance rate, in percent of the straight-line rate (200 for double declining balance).

FACT(x).description: In an equation: the factorial of a whole number x.

FATH.description: A length in fathoms: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to fathoms.

FEET.description: A length in feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to feet.

FIN.description: Opens the finance menus: TVM, ICONV, CFLO, BOND, DEPRC.

FIND.description: Searches the list for the characters you type.

FIX.description: Sets how many decimal places numbers show: type 0 to 11, then INPUT.

FL.OZ.description: A volume in US fluid ounces: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US fluid ounces.

FLOW(list:n).description: In an equation: flow number n of the named CFLO list.

FP(x).description: In an equation: the fractional part of x.

FRCST.description: Two-list statistics: choose the x list, the y list and a model, then the menu for forecasts, curve fitting, plots, weighted mean and summations.

FV.description: The future value: the amount at the close of the last period. Money paid out is negative.

FV(n:i%yr:pv:pmt:p/yr:m).description: In an equation: the future value, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

G.SD.description: In the FRCST menu: the standard deviation of the x values grouped by the frequencies in the y list.

GAL.description: A volume in US gallons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US gallons.

GET (CFLO).description: Switches to another named cash-flow list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

GET (SUM).description: Switches to another named SUM list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

GET (TEXT).description: Switches to another named TEXT list, or starts a new one (*NEW).

GLOBL.description: Replaces the label of every item in the list with the text typed.

GR.description: A mass in grains: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to grains.

GRAM.description: A mass in grams: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to grams.

HA.description: An area in hectares: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to hectares.

HELP (APPT).description: Shows the formats for an appointment's date and time.

HELP (SET).description: Shows how to key in the date and the time.

HIST.description: Draws a histogram of the list.

HMS(t).description: In an equation: hours with a decimal fraction turned into HH.MMSS.

HR.description: Repeats the appointment every so many hours (the number shown).

HRS(t).description: In an equation: a time in HH.MMSS turned into hours with a decimal fraction.

HYP.description: Opens the menu of hyperbolic functions, with their inverses.

I% (CFLO).description: The interest rate per period used for NPV, NUS and NFV (cost of capital, discount rate).

I%YR.description: The nominal yearly interest rate, in percent. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

I%YR(n:pv:pmt:fv:p/yr:m).description: In an equation: the yearly interest rate in percent, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

I.GAL.description: A volume in Imperial gallons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to Imperial gallons.

ICONV.description: Interest conversion: between nominal and effective yearly rates, for periodic or continuous compounding.

IDIV(x:y).description: In an equation: the whole-number part of x divided by y.

IF(cond:then:else).description: In an equation: the value of then when cond is true, else the value of else. Conditions use = < > ≤ ≥ ≠ and AND, OR, XOR, NOT.

INCH.description: A length in inches: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to inches.

INPUT.description: Enters what the calculator line holds: an item into a list, an equation, text, or an answer to a prompt.

INS.description: Switches between inserting characters at the cursor and typing over them.

INSRT (CFLO).description: Inserts a flow before the one shown.

INSRT (SUM).description: Inserts an item before the one shown.

INT.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to interest.

INT(x).description: In an equation: the largest whole number not above x.

INTL.description: Opens the choice of language for messages and labels.

IP(x).description: In an equation: the integer part of x, its fraction dropped.

IRR%.description: The internal rate of return per period: the discount rate that makes NPV of the flows zero.

ITEM(list:n).description: In an equation: item number n of the named SUM list.

KG.description: A mass in kilograms: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to kilograms.

KM.description: A length in kilometres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to kilometres.

L.CWT.description: A mass in long hundredweights: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to long hundredweights.

L.TON.description: A mass in long tons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to long tons.

LABEL.description: Gives the item shown a label of its own (CURR) or every item the same label (GLOBL).

LAST.description: Copies the number on line 2 (the last result) into the calculation in progress. In RPN mode it recalls the LAST X register.

LB.description: A mass in pounds: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to pounds.

LIFE.description: The useful life in whole years.

LIN.description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits a straight line, y = B + M·x.

LIST.description: Prints the values of the menu on display, or the list it shows, or the appointments in the APPT menu.

LITER.description: A volume in litres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to litres.

LN.description: The natural (base e) logarithm of the number shown.

LN(x).description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of x.

LNP1(x).description: In an equation: the natural logarithm of 1 + x, exact for small x.

LOG.description: Base-10 logarithm of the number shown.

LOG (FRCST).description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits a logarithmic curve, y = B + M·ln x.

LOG(x).description: In an equation: the base-10 logarithm of x.

LOGS.description: Opens the logarithms, powers of 10 and e, and (HYP) the hyperbolic functions.

M (FRCST).description: In the FRCST menu: the M coefficient of the model; the slope for the linear one.

M (LENG).description: A length in metres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to metres.

M%C.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of COST. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

M%P.description: The markup (PRICE less COST) as a percentage of PRICE. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

M/D.description: Switches the date format from month/day/year to day.month.year and back.

MAIN.description: Goes straight back to the MAIN menu from any menu.

MARK.description: Adds a record marker below the current entry, so entries group into records.

MASS.description: Opens the mass and weight units.

MAT.description: The maturity date, or the call date (which must be a coupon date).

MATH.description: Opens the MATH menu: rounding, π, logarithms and hyperbolic functions, trigonometry, conversions and probability.

MAX.description: The biggest number of the list.

MAX(x:y).description: In an equation: the larger of x and y.

MEAN.description: The average (arithmetic mean) of the list.

MEM.description: Shows how many bytes of memory are free while the key is held.

MG.description: A mass in milligrams: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to milligrams.

MILE.description: A length in miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to miles.

MIN (RPT).description: Repeats the appointment every so many minutes (the number shown).

MIN (SUM).description: The smallest value of the list.

MIN(x:y).description: In an equation: the smaller of x and y.

ML.description: A volume in millilitres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to millilitres.

MM.description: A length in millimetres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to millimetres.

MOD(x:y).description: In an equation: the remainder of x divided by y, x − y·INT(x/y).

MODES.description: Opens the MODES menu: the angle mode, the beeper, the printer's power, the language, the demo, and (MORE) ALG or RPN entry.

MORE (BOND).description: The second BOND menu: YLD%, PRICE, ACCRU.

MORE (CONV).description: The second CONV menu: polar and rectangular coordinates.

MORE (DEPRC).description: The second DEPRC menu: YR#, FACT% and the three methods.

MORE (SUM CALC).description: The second CALC menu: MIN, MAX, SORT, FRCST, HIST.

MORE (SUM).description: The second SUM menu: COPY, LABEL, START, SUBT.

MORE (TEXT).description: The second TEXT menu: FIND, EDIT, PREV, NEXT, SORT.

MSG.description: Types or shows the appointment's message.

MU%C.description: Markup on cost: a menu with COST, PRICE and M%C.

MU%P.description: Markup on price: the menu of COST, PRICE and M%P.

N.description: How many payments or compounding periods there are. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the others. ⇧ N stores the number shown times P/YR (years to payments).

N!.description: The factorial of the number shown, a whole number from 0 to 253.

N(i%yr:pv:pmt:fv:p/yr:m).description: In an equation: the number of payments, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

N.MI.description: A length in nautical miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to nautical miles.

NAME (CFLO).description: Names or renames the current cash-flow list.

NAME (SUM).description: Names or renames the current SUM list.

NAME (TEXT).description: Names or renames the current TEXT list.

NEW.description: The new value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from OLD and %CH.

NEXT (AMRT).description: Works out the next schedule of #P payments.

NEXT (TEXT).description: Jumps to the entry under the next record marker.

NFV.description: The net future value: NPV carried forward to the last period at I%.

NOM% (CONT).description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded continuously. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

NOM% (PER).description: The nominal yearly rate in percent, compounded P times a year. Stores the number shown, or works it out from EFF%.

NOT.description: In an equation's condition: true when what follows is false.

NPV.description: NPV of the cash flows at the rate I%: their net present value.

NUS.description: The net uniform series: the equal flow per period whose present value equals NPV.

OLD.description: The old value of a percent change. Stores the number shown, or works it out from NEW and %CH.

ON.description: Turns the calculator on; pressed while it is on, turns it off. Continuous memory keeps everything. Also ends the demo.

OR.description: In an equation's condition: true when either side is true.

OTHER.description: The second TVM menu: payments per year, begin or end mode, amortisation.

OZ.description: A mass in ounces: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to ounces.

OZ.T.description: A mass in troy ounces: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to troy ounces.

P.description: How many times a year interest is compounded.

P/YR.description: Sets how many payments there are per year, 1 to 999.

PART.description: The share of TOTAL. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

PECK.description: A volume in pecks: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to pecks.

PER.description: Periodic compounding: the menu of NOM%, EFF% and P.

PERM(x:y).description: In an equation: how many ordered arrangements of y items there are out of x.

PI.description: Puts π (3.14159265359) into the calculator line.

PINT.description: A volume in US pints: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US pints.

PLOT (CFLO).description: Plots NPV against I% from −18% to 50%; the arrow keys move a cursor along the curve.

PLOT (FRCST).description: In the FRCST menu: plots the x,y points and the fitted curve.

PMT.description: The amount of each equal payment. Money paid out is negative. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

PMT(n:i%yr:pv:fv:p/yr:m).description: In an equation: the payment, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

PREV.description: Jumps to the entry under the previous record marker.

PRICE (BOND).description: The price per 100 of face value. Stores the number shown, or works it out from YLD%.

PRICE (MU%C).description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%C.

PRICE (MU%P).description: The selling price. Stores the number shown, or works it out from COST and M%P.

PRIN.description: The part of the amortised payments that went to principal.

PRINTER.description: Opens the PRINTER menu: print the display, the current menu's values or list, the registers or the time; double spacing; trace printing.

PRNT.description: Prints the calculator line on the infrared printer. With letters typed (no menu asking for them), prints them as a message.

PRNTR.description: Tells the calculator whether the printer runs on its AC adapter (it then prints faster) or on batteries.

PROB.description: Opens combinations, permutations, factorial and random numbers.

PV.description: The present value: the loan amount or the first investment, at the start of the first period. Money paid out is negative.

PV(n:i%yr:pmt:fv:p/yr:m).description: In an equation: the present value, from the other TVM values; m is 1 for Begin mode, 0 for End mode.

PWR.description: After FRCST and the two lists: fits a power curve, y = B·x^M.

PX,Y.description: The number of permutations: ordered arrangements of Y items out of X.

QUART.description: A volume in US quarts: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to US quarts.

R.description: The radius (distance from the origin) of a point: stored, or worked out from XCORD and YCORD.

RAD(x).description: In an equation: x decimal degrees in radians.

RADIUS(x:y).description: In an equation: the distance of the point (x, y) from the origin.

RAN#.description: A random number from 0 up to 1. STO RAN# seeds it with the number shown (0 takes a seed from the clock).

RANG.description: The biggest number of the list less the smallest.

RATE.description: The exchange rate: how many units of the second currency make one of the first. Stores the number shown, or works it out from the two amounts.

RCL.description: Copies a register (followed by a digit 0-9) or a menu variable (followed by its menu key) into the calculator line, without calculating it.

RND.description: Rounds the number shown to the decimal places on display; later calculations use the rounded value.

RND(x:y).description: In an equation: x rounded to y places after the point (y from 0 to 11), or to −y significant digits (y from −12 to −1).

ROD.description: A length in rods: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to rods.

RPN.description: RPN entry: 2 ENTER 3 + gives 5. The = key becomes ENTER and the stack's X register is the calculator line.

RPT.description: Shows how often the appointment repeats and opens the menu to change it.

R↓.description: In RPN mode, rolls the stack down: X goes to T and the others move down.

S(var).description: In an equation: true when the Solver is solving for var. With IF it puts several related equations into one menu.

SALV.description: The salvage value left when the asset's life ends (0 if none).

SELCT.description: Chooses the two currencies from the menus of about forty (US$, CAN$, DM, FF, UK£ and more under MORE); a key for any other is there too.

SEMI.description: Coupons are paid twice a year.

SET.description: Opens the menu that sets the date and time and their formats.

SETT.description: The settlement (purchase) date, keyed in the date format in use.

SGN(x).description: In an equation: 1 when x is positive, 0 when it is zero, −1 when it is negative.

SHOW.description: Shows the number with all its 12 digits while the key is held.

SIN.description: The sine of the number shown, in degrees or radians as the angle mode says.

SIN(x).description: In an equation: the sine of x, in the angle mode in use.

SINH.description: The hyperbolic sine of the number shown.

SINH(x).description: In an equation: the hyperbolic sine of x.

SIZE.description: In the FRCST menu: how many items each of the two lists holds.

SIZEC(list).description: In an equation: the number of the final flow of the named CFLO list.

SIZES(list).description: In an equation: how many items the named SUM list holds.

SL.description: Depreciation by the straight-line method for the year in YR#.

SLUG.description: A mass in slugs: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to slugs.

SOLVE.description: Opens the Solver: type your own equations and solve them for any variable.

SORT (SUM).description: Sorts the list from the smallest number up; labels stay with their numbers.

SORT (TEXT).description: Sorts the list alphabetically, after asking.

SOYD.description: Depreciation for the year in YR# by the SOYD method (sum of the years' digits).

SPACE.description: Types a space; in letter typing, inserts one at the cursor.

SPFV(i%:n).description: In an equation: what 1 paid now is worth after n periods at i% per period, (1 + i%/100)^n.

SPPV(i%:n).description: In an equation: what 1 paid after n periods at i% per period is worth now, 1/SPFV(i%:n).

SQ.CM.description: An area in square centimetres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square centimetres.

SQ.FT.description: An area in square feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square feet.

SQ.IN.description: An area in square inches: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square inches.

SQ.K.description: An area in square kilometres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square kilometres.

SQ.M.description: An area in square metres: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square metres.

SQ.MI.description: An area in square miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square miles.

SQ.RD.description: An area in square rods: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square rods.

SQ.YD.description: An area in square yards: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a area was stored in another unit of AREA, converts it to square yards.

SQRT(x).description: In an equation: the square root of x.

ST.MI.description: A length in US statute miles: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to US statute miles.

START (SUM).description: Marks the item shown as the start of a subtotal.

START (TABLE).description: Prints the amortisation table up to the payment number shown.

STDEV.description: The sample standard deviation of the list.

STO.description: Stores the number shown: then press a digit 0-9 for a register or a menu key for a variable. STO + − × ÷ before the register does the arithmetic in it.

STONE.description: A mass in stones: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to stones.

SU.FT.description: A length in survey feet: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to survey feet.

SUBT.description: The subtotal from the START item to the item shown.

SUM.description: Opens SUM: lists of numbers with their running total, subtotals, labels and statistics.

T.description: A mass in metric tons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to metric tons.

TABLE.description: Opens the printing of an amortisation table: type the number of the final payment to print, then press START.

TAN.description: The tangent of the number shown, in the angle mode in use.

TAN(x).description: In an equation: the tangent of x, in the angle mode in use.

TANH.description: The hyperbolic tangent of the number shown.

TANH(x).description: In an equation: the hyperbolic tangent of x.

TBSP.description: A volume in tablespoons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to tablespoons.

TEXT.description: Opens TEXT: lists of notes, names and addresses, with record markers, searching and sorting.

TIME.description: Shows the date and time and opens the TIME menu: date arithmetic, appointments, adjusting and setting the clock.

TIME (APPT).description: Sets the appointment's time to the time shown (HH.MM); a past date becomes today.

TIME (SET).description: Sets the time to the number shown (HH.MMSS).

TODAY.description: Puts today's date into the calculator line, to store in DATE1 or DATE2.

TON.description: A mass in short tons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a mass was stored in another unit of MASS, converts it to short tons.

TOTAL (%TOTL).description: The whole amount, of which PART is a share. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

TOTAL (CFLO).description: All the cash flows of the list added up.

TOTAL (SUM).description: All the numbers of the list added up.

TRACE.description: Turns trace printing on or off: with it on, every calculation is printed as it is done.

TRN(x:y).description: In an equation: x cut off (not rounded) to y decimal places, or to −y significant digits when y is negative.

TSP.description: A volume in teaspoons: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a volume was stored in another unit of VOL, converts it to teaspoons.

TVM.description: Time value of money: works out loans, savings, leases and their amortisation from five values (PV, PMT, FV, N and I%YR).

TYPE.description: Opens the menu of bond types: calendar and coupon frequency.

UNITS.description: Unit conversions: length, area, volume, mass and temperature. In one of their menus, store a value in one unit, then press another unit to convert it.

USFV(i%:n).description: In an equation: the future value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

USPV(i%:n).description: In an equation: the present value of n payments of 1 at i% per period.

W.MN.description: In the FRCST menu: the mean of the x values weighted by the y list.

WEEK.description: Repeats the appointment every so many weeks (the number shown).

X (PROB).description: The number of items to choose from, for CX,Y and PX,Y.

XCOORD(r:a).description: In an equation: the x coordinate of the polar point (r, a), angle a in the mode in use.

XCORD.description: The x coordinate of a point. Store XCORD and YCORD, then R or ∡ gives the polar form; or store R and ∡ and this works x out.

XLIST.description: In the FRCST menu (its label is the x list's name): store an x value to forecast y, or forecast x from a stored y.

XOR.description: In an equation's condition: true when exactly one side is true.

Y (PROB).description: The number of items chosen, for CX,Y and PX,Y.

YARD.description: A length in yards: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a length was stored in another unit of LENG, converts it to yards.

YCOORD(r:a).description: In an equation: the y coordinate of the polar point (r, a), angle a in the mode in use.

YCORD.description: The y coordinate of a point: stored, or worked out from R and ∡.

YLD%.description: The yearly yield in percent, to maturity or to the call date. Stores the number shown, or works it out from PRICE.

YLIST.description: In the FRCST menu (its label is the y list's name): store a y value to forecast x, or forecast y from a stored x.

YR#.description: The year to depreciate: 1, 2 and so on.

^.description: Raises the number before it to the power of the next one: 2 ^ 3 = 8.

x².description: The square of the number shown.

x≷y.description: Swaps the last two numbers of the history stack (in RPN the X and Y registers).

°C.description: A temperature in degrees Celsius: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to degrees Celsius.

°F.description: A temperature in degrees Fahrenheit: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to degrees Fahrenheit.

°K.description: A temperature in kelvins: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to kelvins.

°R.description: A temperature in degrees Rankine: stores the number keyed in; pressed right after a temperature was stored in another unit of TEMP, converts it to degrees Rankine.

×.description: Multiplies the number before it by the next one.

÷.description: Divides the number before it by the next one.

Σ (key).description: Types the Σ character, for the summation function in an equation.

Σ(ctr:c1:c2:s:expr).description: In an equation: the sum of expr as the counter ctr runs from c1 to c2 in steps of s.

ΣX.description: In the FRCST menu: the sum of the x list.

ΣX2.description: In the FRCST menu: the x values squared and added up.

ΣXY.description: In the FRCST menu: each x times its y, added up.

ΣY.description: In the FRCST menu: the sum of the y list.

ΣY2.description: In the FRCST menu: the y values squared and added up.

↑.description: Rolls the history stack up; in a list or the Solver, moves to the previous item or equation.

→DEG.description: Turns an angle in radians into decimal degrees.

→HMS.description: Turns decimal hours (or degrees) into H.MMSS form.

→HR.description: Turns hours (or degrees) in H.MMSS form into decimal hours.

→RAD.description: Turns an angle in decimal degrees into radians.

↓.description: Rolls the history stack down; in a list or the Solver, moves to the next item or equation.

⇤.description: Moves the cursor to the line's first character.

⇥.description: Moves the cursor after the line's last character.

−.description: Subtracts the next number from the one before it.

√x.description: Square root of the number shown.

∡.description: The polar angle of a point, in the angle mode in use: stored, or worked out from XCORD and YCORD.

▶.description: Moves the cursor right by one character.

◀.description: Moves the cursor left by one character.

⬅.description: Backspace: erases the last character typed, or the whole number when no cursor shows.

#P.description: Stores how many payments to amortise (1 to 1,200) and works out that schedule; the next one starts where it left off.

%.description: Percent: after + or −, takes that percentage of the number before it (200 − 25 % takes off 50); otherwise divides the number by 100.

%CH.description: The change from OLD to NEW as a percentage of OLD. Stores the number shown, or works it out.

%CHG.description: Percent change: the menu of OLD, NEW and %CH.

(.description: Opens a parenthesis, so the part inside is worked out first.

+.description: Adds the next number to the one before it.

+/-.description: Makes the number being typed, or the result shown, negative or positive again.

+HR.description: Moves the clock one hour forward.

+MIN.description: Moves the clock one minute forward.

+SEC.description: Moves the clock one second forward.

-HR.description: Moves the clock one hour back.

-MIN.description: Moves the clock one minute back.

-SEC.description: Moves the clock one second back.

./,.description: Swaps the roles of the period and the comma in numbers: 1,234.50 or 1.234,50.

1/x.description: The reciprocal of the number shown.

12/24.description: Switches between the 12-hour and the 24-hour clock.

360D.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 counted with 30-day months and a 360-day year.

365D.description: The days from DATE1 to DATE2 on a 365-day calendar, ignoring leap days.

=.description: Finishes the calculation on the calculator line and shows the result. Operators work in the order they are typed (no precedence) unless parentheses group them.

A/PM (APPT).description: Switches the appointment's time from AM to PM or back (12-hour clock).

A/PM (SET).description: Switches the clock between AM and PM.

ABS.description: The number shown without its sign.

ABS(x).description: In an equation: x without its sign.

ACOS.description: The arc cosine of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

ACOS(x).description: In an equation: the arc cosine of x, in the angle mode in use.

ACOSH.description: Inverse hyperbolic cosine of the number shown (1 or more).

ACOSH(x).description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic cosine of x.

ADJST.description: Opens the menu that moves the clock forward or back by an hour, a minute or a second.

ALL.description: Shows numbers with as many digits as they need, up to 12.

ALOG(x).description: In an equation: 10 to the power x.

AMRT.description: Opens the amortisation menu, which splits payments into interest and principal and shows the balance.

AND.description: In an equation's condition: true when both sides are true.

ANGLE(x:y).description: In an equation: the polar angle of (x, y) as a point, in the angle mode in use.

APPT.description: Opens the ten appointments, with which are set and which are overdue.

APT1.description: Opens an appointment (APT1 to APT5 here, APT6 to APT10 under MORE) to set or see its date, time, message and repeat.

ASIN.description: The arc sine of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

ASIN(x).description: In an equation: the arc sine of x, in the angle mode in use.

ASINH(x).description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic sine of x.

ASNH.description: Inverse hyperbolic sine of the number shown.

ATAN.description: The arc tangent of the number shown, as an angle in the mode in use.

ATAN(x).description: In an equation: the arc tangent of x, in the angle mode in use.

ATANH(x).description: In an equation: the inverse hyperbolic tangent of x.

ATNH.description: Inverse hyperbolic tangent of the number shown (between −1 and 1).

B.description: The B coefficient of the chosen model; the y-intercept for the linear one.

BAL.description: What is left of the loan after the amortised payments.

BASE.description: Opens the BASE menu: numbers show in base 10, 16, 8 or 2, and arithmetic works in that base.

BEEP.description: Steps through the beeper settings: on, on for appointments only, off.

BEG.description: Begin mode: payments come at the start of each period, as with leases and savings plans.

CALC (SOLVE).description: Checks the current equation and makes a menu of its variables, to store values and solve for any one of them.

CALC (STAT).description: Opens the statistics of the current list: total, mean, median, deviation, range, and FRCST for two lists.

CALC (TIME).description: Opens date arithmetic: the day of the week, days between dates, a date some days away.

CDATE.description: In an equation: today's date, from the clock.

CLEAR DATA.description: Clears the data of the application on display: the TVM variables, the STAT list, the Solver's equations (after asking). In the MAIN display it clears the history stack.

CLR.description: Clears the calculator line. Pressed while the calculator is off, it turns it on.

COMB(x:y).description: In an equation: how many ways there are to choose y items out of x, order not counted.

CONVERT.description: Opens the conversions: degrees and radians, decimal hours and hours-minutes-seconds, and (MORE) polar and rectangular coordinates.

CORR.description: The correlation coefficient, from −1 to +1: how well the chosen model fits the two lists.

COS.description: The cosine of the number shown, in the angle mode in use.

COS(x).description: In an equation: the cosine of x, in the angle mode in use.

COSH.description: The hyperbolic cosine of the number shown.

COSH(x).description: In an equation: the hyperbolic cosine of x.

CTIME.description: In an equation: the time now, from the clock.

CX,Y.description: The number of combinations: ways to choose Y items out of X, order not counted.

D/R.description: Switches the angle mode between degrees and radians; RAD shows in radians mode.

D/R (CONVERT).description: Switches the angle mode between degrees and radians; RAD shows in radians mode.

DATE (APPT).description: Sets the appointment's date to the date shown.

DATE (SET).description: Sets the date to the number shown (MM.DDYYYY or DD.MMYYYY).

DATE(d1:n).description: In an equation: the date n days after d1 (before it when n is negative), in the date format set in TIME SET.
